model: AXIS Camera Station S1232 Rack Recording Server
series: AXIS Camera Station S12 Recording Server Series

storage.built_in: S1232 Rack 16 TB: 16 TB (4x4 TB) hot-swappable Enterprise Class SATA HDD, 12 TB after factory RAID 5. S1232 Rack 32 TB: 32 TB (4x8 TB), 24 TB after factory RAID 5. 480 GB SSD operating system drive

power.supply: 2 x 600 W hot-plug redundant power supplies (100–240 V AC, 7.1–3.6 A, 50/60 Hz)

features: 32 AXIS Camera Station Pro Core Device NVR licenses and 10 AXIS Audio Manager Pro licenses included
Qualified for 128 doors, 64 video channels at 4 MP, 30 fps in a retail scenario
Not intended for local viewing of video; Axis workstations recommended
iDRAC 9 basic license; 1x iDRAC dedicated Ethernet port
Can be scaled with more devices when using AXIS S30 Recorder Series
Qualified for 200 simultaneous audio streams using AXIS Audio Manager Pro
Qualified for up to 1,000 doors with access control only
FIPS 140-2 level 2 certified Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0); support for encrypted operating system and recording drives
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption of 127 W typical and 158 W maximum.
weight_g is for the 16 TB variant; datasheet gives 12.9 kg (16 TB) and 12.7 kg (32 TB; 12.9 kg for units produced before 1 September 2024).
dimensions_mm: 42.8 x 482 x 585.3 (height x width x depth without bezel)
